puzzle.hint: Allah's answer to the prayer of Yunus in the belly of the whale and His promise to all believers
puzzle.arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
puzzle.verseEn: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
